This aggressive multiple sits on top of catastrophic profitability and return metrics, including an atrocious Return on Equity of -75.0% and a Return on Assets of -39.42% [E7, E12]. Operational decay is starkly visible as operating margins plummeted to -183% in March 2022, representing an 188 percentage point collapse over three years [E20]. Furthermore, the business is cash-destructive, posting a negative operating cash flow of Rs -0.56 Cr and negative free cash flow of Rs -0.60 Cr in March 2022 [E24, E25], while promoters hold a low 20.5% stake [E39]. However, the bear exaggerates valuation concerns while ignoring the company's robust balance sheet flexibility and top-line momentum [E13, E14, E27, E28]. This strong revenue expansion is paired with recent operational improvements, as profit and sales are both up quarter-over-quarter, with recent profit growth even exceeding one-year price growth by 27% to signal outperforming expectations [E34, E42, E43].

Conceded: compounded sales growth over 3 years is 15% and trailing twelve months compounded sales growth reaches 86% [E13, E14]. However, this top-line expansion is completely decoupled from profitability, as trailing twelve months compounded profit growth sits at -17% [E15], demonstrating that revenue scaling is failing to generate bottom-line returns. While the bull points to a pristine debt-free status and comfortable short-term liquidity [E27, E28], cash-burn renders these financial cushions precarious, evidenced by negative operating cash flow of Rs -0.56 Cr and negative free cash flow of Rs -0.60 Cr [E24, E25]. The bull's reliance on short-term quarter-over-quarter metrics [E42, E43] ignores the severe longer-term structural decay reflected in a median 3-year return on equity of -58% [E18] and a plummeting operating margin of -183% [E20]. Furthermore, citing recent relative outperformance based on price-to-growth dynamics [E34] rings hollow when the stock sits at the absolute bottom 0% of its 52-week range [E4] alongside a 44% one-year price decline [E17]. Finally, the low promoter holding of 20.5% [E39] offers minimal insider alignment to weather these deeply negative return metrics, including an ROE and ROCE sitting at -75.0% [E11, E12].
